title: HPS Seminar: Poetry session, in memory of Lieke Marsman (1990–2026)
reading: L. Marsman, Op een andere planeet kunnen ze mij redden (Pluim 2025); in English: On Another Planet They Can Save Me, translated by Sophie Collins (Catapult 2026)
description: HPS Seminar (coordinated by Daan Wegener and Antonio Ferreiro de Aguiar). Participants read the text in advance and send their reading notes a day before. In person only. Room: see MyTimetable.
